issues.problem: English adds the specification 'the eastern gate of Daliang' for the Yimen; the Chinese says only that he was gatekeeper of the Yimen at Daliang (大梁夷门的守门人) without the 'eastern' detail.
issues.suggestion: Drop 'eastern' so it reads 'the Yimen gate of Daliang'.

overall: The English edition matches the Chinese in content, facts, quotations and hedges throughout, with only one minor added geographic detail.
